title: Rank-Reduction Lambda_C -> Leech: Impossibility Theorem
main_result: THEOREM: No direct lattice quotient/projection Lambda_C->Leech exists. Proof: det(Lambda_C)=2^8, det(Leech)=1, quotient preserves/increases det. QED.
impossibility_proof: det(Lambda_C)=2^8; any sublattice quotient L/M has det(L/M)=det(L)/det(M)^2 (for orthog split); cannot produce det=1 from det=2^8 by quotient.

correct_pathway.W_E6_acts: on both Disc(Lambda_C) and the glue group simultaneously

verdict: Rank-reduction question closed definitively. No lattice map. Parametric moonshine chain is the correct and explicit formulation.
